title: Sum and difference
description:
Read two whole numbers with `read_int`, then print their sum and difference with the print routines, like this for the input `30 12`:

```
30 + 12 = 42
30 - 12 = 18
sum in hex: 0x2a
```

Keep the numbers in registers the routines leave alone (`rbx`, `r12` to `r15`). `sub rax, rsi` subtracts rsi from rax. For the text pieces, define zero-terminated strings such as `plus: db " + ", 0` and print them with `print_str`.

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .text
_start:
        call    read_int
        mov     rdi, rax
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

solution.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
plus:   db      " + ", 0
minus:  db      " - ", 0
equals: db      " = ", 0
hex:    db      "sum in hex: ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        call    read_int
        mov     rbx, rax                ; a
        call    read_int
        mov     r12, rax                ; b

        mov     rdi, rbx
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel plus]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel equals]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        add     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        mov     rdi, rbx
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel minus]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel equals]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        sub     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        lea     rdi, [rel hex]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        add     rdi, r12
        call    print_hex
        call    print_newline

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall
